info.syllabusName: 3D Character Animation_Tạo chuyển động trong môi trường 3D
info.prerequisite: Passed (ANR401 or ANR402) or passed (AMR401 or AMR402)
info.description: This course covers character rigging and animation in Maya. Students will learn to rig characters, animate with keyframe techniques, analyze body language and expressions and apply animation principles for realistic motion. They will be able to create and render a short animation scene using Maya and compositing software while also developing a positive and professional working style.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes.
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information.

clos.loDetails: Animate objects and the characters using keyframe animation techniques in Maya
Analyze body language, body mechanics and facial expressions
Apply animation principles to create convincing motion
Develop skills in animating the characters depicting body mechanics and facial expressions
Create and render animation a short scene using Maya and compositing software
Demonstrate a positive attitude and a professional working style.

assessments.gradingGuide:
The evaluation will consider the following criteria: Amount of work on rigging character (60%) and Presentation (25%), and ability to explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%)
Evaluation criteria proposed by teachers in the teaching process

assessments.knowledgeSkill: An individual work to animate an object moves among obstacles.
assessments.gradingGuide:
The evaluation will consider the following criteria: Amount of work of animating object (60%) applying animation's principles and techniques (25%), and ability to present, explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%)
Evaluation criteria proposed by teachers in the teaching process

assessments.knowledgeSkill: An individual work to animate a walking cycle
assessments.gradingGuide:
The evaluation will consider the following criteria: Amount of work of animating a walking cycle (60%) applying animation's principles and techniques (25%), and ability to present, explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%)
Evaluation criteria proposed by teachers in the teaching process
Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions

assessments.knowledgeSkill:
From a short script, create a storyboard for an animation (about 30s), then animate and render it into a short clip
Students can use AI during the ideation stages: creating reference poses, generating camera angles, and developing mood boards for lighting and colors.
assessments.gradingGuide:
The evaluation will consider the following criteria: Animation quality and effort in creating a scene: 50%. Application of animation principles and techniques: 30%. Effective use of AI during the ideation phase: 10%. Presentation skills, including the ability to explain the work and respond to evaluator questions: 10%.
These criteria are defined by teachers as part of the teaching process.
assessments.note:
Individual

When submitting their work, students must include a report that details:
- The AI tools used
- The prompts used
- The AI-generated images used for reference
- Additionally, they should include other reference sources, if any (from the internet, self-shot materials, etc.).
